pairs.locus: Varro De Lingua Latina fragment 6 (Liber IX)
pairs.question: Et ubi auctoritas maiorum genus tibi non demonstraverit, quid ibi faciendum est?
pairs.answer: Potestatis nostrae est illis rebus dare genera, quae ex natura genus non habent.
pairs.derivation: The text poses a real interrogative (quid ibi faciendum est?) about what to do when the authority of the ancients does not show the gender, and answers it with Varro's reply. Dropped the framing tag 'Scripsit Varro ad Ciceronem:' that narrates the answering; kept the question's setup ('Et ubi auctoritas maiorum genus tibi non demonstraverit') so 'ibi' has its referent. Answer ends at the full stop; nothing was trimmed from it (the section opens the next paragraph, fragment 7 A).
